system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 45. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (44 seconds, code score 0.86) ---
[b00] ACTION: Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.
[b01] JULIANA (shocked, wondering): "You're the Duke?"
[b02] ALEXANDER (firm, resonant): "Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."
[b03] JULIANA (incredulous, moved): "All this time?"
[b04] ALEXANDER (tender, deep): "You chose me when you believed I was nobody."
[b05] JULIANA (sincere, loving): "I chose you because you were kind."
[b06] ALEXANDER (low, passionate): "You chose me when I had nothing."
[b07] JULIANA (resolute, warm): "I chose you because you had honor."
[b08] ALEXANDER (earnest, devoted): "And I chose you because you saw the man before the title."
[b09] ACTION: Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.
[b10] JULIANA (soft, heartfelt): "I loved you before I ever knew who you were."
[b11] ALEXANDER (soft, vowing): "And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you."
[b12] ACTION: Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.
[b13] CATHERINE (pleading, desperate): "Alexander..."
[b14] ALEXANDER (furious, cold): "You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife."
[b15] CATHERINE (gasping, lying): "I didn't know!"
[b16] ALEXANDER (thunderous, biting): "You knew exactly what you were doing!"
[b17] ALEXANDER (booming, condemning): "You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife."

--- WINDOW 1 (33 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (gasping, lying): "I didn't know!"
[b01] ALEXANDER (thunderous, biting): "You knew exactly what you were doing!"
[b02] ALEXANDER (booming, condemning): "You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife."
[b03] CATHERINE (trembling, stunned): "Wife?!"
[b04] ACTION: Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.
[b05] ALEXANDER (authoritative, resounding): "Before the Crown and before God..."
[b06] ACTION: Alexander hoists Juliana's hand triumphantly into the air, presenting her to the nobility.
[b07] ALEXANDER (proclaiming, powerful): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!"
[b08] RUPERT (gasping, shellshocked): "Juliana?!"
[b09] SFX: Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
[b10] ACTION: A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.
[b11] HIGH PRIEST (booming, stern): "No one will bow yet!"

--- WINDOW 2 (25 seconds, code score 0.84) ---
[b00] ACTION: A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.
[b01] HIGH PRIEST (booming, stern): "No one will bow yet!"
[b02] ACTION: The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.
[b03] HIGH PRIEST (commanding, severe): "This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."
[b04] HIGH PRIEST (stern, official): "These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."
[b05] HIGH PRIEST (harsh, resolute): "Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton."
[b06] HIGH PRIEST (unyielding, condemning): "You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."

--- WINDOW 3 (20 seconds, code score 0.77) ---
[b00] ACTION: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, looking up at her with profound devotion.
[b01] ALEXANDER (gentle, reassuring): "Look at me."
[b02] SFX: Heavy iron clanking as the shackles fall away.
[b03] JULIANA (breathless, overcome): "Your eyes..."
[b04] ACTION: Juliana places her palm against Alexander's beard, feeling his scarred face as recognition dawns.
[b05] JULIANA (emotional, realizing): "It's you."
[b06] ALEXANDER (solemn, loving): "It was always me."
[b07] ACTION: Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.
[b08] JULIANA (shocked, wondering): "You're the Duke?"
[b09] ALEXANDER (firm, resonant): "Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."

Pick the single best promo.
